_readme: Config and results for the Canadian AI Pulse reader survey.
COLLECTION happens off-site. GitHub Pages is static — it cannot receive or
aggregate form submissions — so responses are gathered with a free external
form (Google Forms, Tally, etc.) and the tallies are recorded here.
TO SWITCH IT ON: put your form's URL in form_url. Until that is set, no
survey call-to-action appears in any post.
TO PUBLISH A WAVE: add an entry to waves[] with the counts you got, then run
the publish workflow (or python3 scripts/survey.py). The results page is
written only when at least one wave is present, so nothing is ever published
claiming data that does not exist.
Report n honestly. A small sample openly labelled is citable; a small sample
presented as authoritative is the thing that gets you discredited.
audience: Readers of AI Insights for Canadian Business — Canadian business and technology leaders

questions.text: Where is your organization with AI today?
What is the single biggest thing blocking you?
How has your AI spend changed in the last six months?
Does your organization have a written AI usage policy?
How many employees does your organization have?
